name: My Zypps - Ounce - Marilla Mangler
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Marilla Mangler ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Marilla Mangler brings a bold, full-bodied profile: sweet dark fruit up front, grounded by earthy, gassy depth and a smooth, peppery finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Marilla Mangler flavor — sweet dark fruit with earthy, gassy depth

My Zypps Marilla Mangler is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
